title: The SNES Console
blurb: A whole Super Nintendo in one folder (Snes9x via EmulatorJS, embedded unmodified) with an empty cartridge slot — players insert their own .sfc/.smc files from their own machine. Freeze a brutal moment and hand the next player its State Code. Note: an SNES State Code is big (the lesson measures one at over a million characters) — it rides the box, but it is the heaviest baton on the shelf.
